response.original_title: {Challenge a Transaction} How to Resolve a Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection Cruise Booking Dispute
response.overview: To dispute a charge with The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection, you must first attempt to resolve the issue directly with customer support or through their formal informal dispute process before contacting your bank. +1-866-259-1002(US) Contact Customer Support Call Customer Service: Reach out to support at to speak with a supervisor or tier-two agent available 24/7. Request a Case Number +1-866-259-1002(US) Clearly explain the unauthorized payment, missing refund, or booking error, and request a case number to track your issue. +1-866-259-1002(US) Use Informal Written Dispute (Per Terms) If it remains unresolved +1-866-259-1002(US) after 60 days, you can move on to formal arbitration or small claims proceedings as outlined in their agreement +1-866-259-1002(US) Contact Your Card Issuer (Last Resort) If the cruise line refuses to issue a valid refund or fix an unauthorized charge, contact your credit card or bank provider.+1-866-259-1002(US)
